profile.headline: Founding Software Engineer at Bambi Health, Inc.
profile.summary:
Results-oriented analyst and programmer with a proven track record of success in providing technical solutions to complex business problems.   Proficient in managing every stage of the software development life cycle, working alone or in small teams.  Extensive experience in assimilating and working with a wide variety of technologies including Business Intelligence and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.  History of mentoring junior developers and creating reusable libraries and application programming interfaces.

Specialties: Interpreting Customer Requirements, Development of Technical Specifications, API Development, Application Development, Web Applications, Database Design, Business Intelligence, Product Lifecycle Management
